name: stock_unindexed_baseline
description: Stock agent baseline: PowerShell Get-ChildItem | Select-String for discovery, full-file read_file for context, cold git diff for changes.

name: fastcore_crepe_only
description: Isolated Instant Crepe Grep: Sparse 3-gram candidate pruning + parallel regex. File reads remain full-file; no AST or Merkle.

name: fastcore_stair_only
description: Isolated STAIR AST Slices: Precision byte-range extraction of functions/classes. Discovery relies on stock grep/find.

name: fastcore_bm25_semantic_only
description: Isolated Pure-Rust BM25 Subword Semantic Search: In-memory trigram subword ranking. Conceptual search without exact identifier names.

name: fastcore_merkle_only
description: Isolated BLAKE3 Merkle State Diffs: Instant dirty file detection (<20µs). Discovery and inspection remain stock.

name: crepe_stair
description: Crepe Grep + STAIR AST Slices: Instant candidate discovery followed immediately by AST definition slicing.

name: crepe_bm25
description: Crepe Grep + BM25 Semantic: Hybrid syntactic + subword conceptual search. Full-file reads used for inspection.

name: crepe_merkle
description: Crepe Grep + Merkle Diffs: Instant search with incremental dirty overlay tracking.

name: stair_bm25
description: STAIR AST Slices + BM25 Semantic: Subword query directly yields symbol path, followed by zero-token-waste AST extraction.

name: stair_merkle
description: STAIR AST Slices + Merkle Diffs: AST definition extraction coupled with microsecond post-edit change verification.

name: bm25_merkle
description: BM25 Semantic + Merkle Diffs: Conceptual search with incremental symbol cache refresh upon file modification.

name: crepe_stair_bm25
description: Crepe + STAIR + BM25: Complete query intelligence stack (exact regex + semantic subword + precision AST extraction).

name: crepe_stair_merkle
description: Crepe + STAIR + Merkle: Exact regex discovery, precision AST slicing, and microsecond dirty diffing.

name: crepe_bm25_merkle
description: Crepe + BM25 + Merkle: Syntactic and semantic search with incremental Merkle cache sync.

name: stair_bm25_merkle
description: STAIR + BM25 + Merkle: Semantic symbol discovery with AST slicing and dirty state diffs.

name: fastcore_quad_standard
description: Full Fast-Core Quad-Stack: All 4 capabilities enabled with default production configuration.

name: quad_cold_cache
description: Quad-Stack Cold Cache: Cleared .antigravity/crepe before invocation. Measures cold index build latency inclusion.

name: quad_warm_mmap
description: Quad-Stack Pre-Warmed Memory Map: lookup.bin and postings.bin pre-mapped into OS page cache.

name: quad_incremental_gen_swap
description: Quad-Stack Incremental Dual-Gen Swap: Modifies files and verifies generation toggling avoiding OS error 1224.

name: crepe_cold_vs_warm
description: Isolated Crepe Cold Index Build: Evaluates stand-alone Crepe index construction latency vs instant queries.

name: quad_stair_tight_slice
description: Quad-Stack Tight AST Slices: Strict symbol boundaries (byte_start..byte_end), maximizing token efficiency.

name: quad_stair_extended_context
description: Quad-Stack Extended AST Slices: Extracts definition + decorators + docstring + 10 lines surrounding context.

name: quad_stair_outline_guided
description: Quad-Stack Outline-Guided: Executes get_symbol_outline (depth 2) to build mental map before surgical definition call.

name: stair_scoped_submodule
description: Scoped STAIR AST Trie: Symbol tree restricted strictly to operations module, evaluating sub-hierarchy build speed.

name: quad_cascade_exact_first
description: Autonomous Cascade Crepe Priority: Crepe Grep executed first; terminates in <25ms on matches; BM25 fallback on 0 hits.

name: quad_cascade_semantic_first
description: Autonomous Cascade Semantic Priority: BM25 subword search executed first; top hit immediately fed to STAIR slice.

name: quad_hybrid_blended_scoring
description: Hybrid Dual-Score Ranking: Combines Crepe n-gram rarity score with BM25 subword score.

name: quad_bm25_pure_rust_cpu
description: Pure-Rust In-Memory BM25: Explicitly enforces CPU-only in-memory subword index, bypassing CUDA sidecars.

name: quad_crepe_inprocess_regex
description: Crepe In-Process Regex DFA: Pruned candidates verified using Rust regex crate in-process memory.

name: quad_crepe_bundled_ripgrep
description: Crepe Bundled Ripgrep Subprocess: Pruned candidates verified by spawning bundled rg.exe subprocess.

name: quad_crepe_case_sensitive
description: Crepe Strict Case-Sensitive: Enforces strict case-sensitive 3-gram pruning and Boyer-Moore verification.

name: quad_single_threaded_rayon1
description: Single-Threaded Pinned: Forces RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1. Isolates raw algorithmic performance without multicore contention.

name: quad_multi_threaded_rayon_max
description: Multi-Threaded Unconstrained: Utilizes all logical CPU cores via Rayon work-stealing pool.

name: quad_constrained_threads_rayon2
description: Constrained Worker Threads: Pins Rayon to 2 threads. Simulates resource-constrained CI runner.

name: quad_merkle_file_diff
description: File-Level Merkle Diff: Standard dirty tracking outputting changed file paths, BLAKE3 hashes, and timestamps.

name: quad_merkle_ast_invalidation
description: AST-Aware Merkle Invalidation: Merkle dirty file diff directly triggers selective AST symbol re-parsing for modified files only.

name: quad_merkle_cumulative_history
description: Cumulative Merkle Baseline Diff: Tracks diffs against the initial pre-task snapshot hash across all multi-turn edits.

name: quad_gpu_vector_rag_sidecar
description: Resident CUDA GPU Sidecar: Dispatches semantic search over HTTP (127.0.0.1:9819) to jina-code-embeddings with pure-Rust fallback.

name: quad_stair_crlf_normalized
description: STAIR Windows CRLF Normalized: Automatically handles Windows \r\n vs Linux \n byte offset translations.

name: quad_resident_mcp_daemon
description: Resident Stdio MCP Server: Agent connects to running stdio daemon with pre-warmed memory state, eliminating process spawn overhead.
